3.english_reference: And [ it was ] covered with cedar above upon the beams

traditions.KJV: And [ it was ] covered with cedar above upon the beams ,

3.english_reference: that [ lay ] on forty five pillars

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָֽ עַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַ חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה

traditions.KJV: that [ lay ] on forty five pillars ,

5.english_reference: And all the doors and posts [ were ] square , with the windows

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל הַ פְּתָחִ֥ים וְ הַ מְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף

traditions.KJV: And all the doors and posts [ were ] square , with the windows :

5.english_reference: and light [ was ] against light [ in ] three ranks

traditions.WLC: וּ מ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים
traditions.KJV: and light [ was ] against light [ in ] three ranks .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν δύο δίκτυα περικαλύψαι τὸ ἐπίθεμα τῶν στύλων , καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δευτέρῳ .

6.english_reference: And he made a porch of pillars

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽ עַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה

traditions.KJV: And he made a porch of pillars ;

traditions.WLC: חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔ וֹ וּ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: quinquagínta cubitórum longitúdinis , et trigínta cubitórum latitúdinis :
traditions.KJV: the length thereof [ was ] fifty cubits , and the breadth thereof thirty cubits :

6.english_reference: and the porch [ was ] before them

traditions.WLC: וְ אוּלָם֙ עַל פְּנֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: et álteram pórticum in fácie maióris pórticus :
traditions.KJV: and the porch [ was ] before them :

6.english_reference: and the [ other ] pillars and the thick beam [ were ] before them

traditions.WLC: וְ עַמֻּדִ֥ים וְ עָ֖ב עַל פְּנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et colúmnas , et epistýlia super colúmnas .
traditions.KJV: and the [ other ] pillars and the thick beam [ were ] before them .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔργον κρεμαστόν , δύο στίχοι ῥοῶν χαλκῶν δεδικτυωμένοι , ἔργον κρεμαστόν , στίχος ἐπὶ στίχον · καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δευτέρῳ .

7.english_reference: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge , [ even ] the porch of judgment

traditions.WLC: וְ אוּלָ֤ם הַ כִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפָּט שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַ מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Pórticum quoque sólii , in qua tribúnal est , fecit :
traditions.KJV: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge , [ even ] the porch of judgment :

7.english_reference: and [ it was ] covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other

traditions.WLC: וְ סָפ֣וּן בָּ אֶ֔רֶז מֵ הַ קַּרְקַ֖ע עַד הַ קַּרְקָֽע
traditions.VUL: et texit lignis cédrinis a paviménto usque ad summitátem .
traditions.KJV: and [ it was ] covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους τοῦ αἰλὰμ τοῦ ναοῦ · καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στύλον τὸν ἕνα καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰαχούμ , καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στύλον τὸν δεύτερον καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ βάλαζ .

8.english_reference: And his house where he dwelt [ had ] another court within the porch , [ which ] was of the like work

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵית וֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָ אַחֶ֗רֶת מִ בֵּית֙ לָֽ אוּלָ֔ם כַּ מַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ זֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Et domúncula , in qua sedebátur ad iudicándum , erat in média pórticu símili ópere .
traditions.KJV: And his house where he dwelt [ had ] another court within the porch , [ which ] was of the like work .

8.english_reference: Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh ’s daughter , whom he had taken [ to wife ] , like unto this porch

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְ בַת פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּ אוּלָ֖ם הַ זֶּֽה

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κεφαλῶν τῶν στύλων ἔργον κρίνου κατὰ τὸ αἰλὰμ τεσσάρων πηχῶν .

9.english_reference: even from the foundation unto the coping , and [ so ] on the outside toward the great court

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ מַּסָּד֙ עַד הַ טְּפָח֔וֹת וּ מִ ח֖וּץ עַד הֶ חָצֵ֥ר הַ גְּדוֹלָֽה

traditions.WLC: וּ מְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת

traditions.VUL: decem sive octo cubitórum .
traditions.KJV: stones , stones of ten cubits , and stones of eight cubits .

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ לְ מַ֗עְלָ ה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּ מִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָ אָֽרֶז

12.english_reference: And the great court round about [ was ] with three rows of hewed stones , and a row of cedar beams ,

14.english_reference: He [ was ] a widow ’s son of the tribe of Naphtali , and his father [ was ] a man of Tyre , a worker in brass :

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִ מַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְ אָבִ֣י ו אִישׁ צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹשֶׁת֒

traditions.KJV: He [ was ] a widow ’s son of the tribe of Naphtali , and his father [ was ] a man of Tyre , a worker in brass :

14.english_reference: and he was filled with wisdom , and understanding , and cunning to work all works in brass .

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יִּמָּלֵא אֶת הַ חָכְמָ֤ה וְ אֶת הַ תְּבוּנָה֙ וְ אֶת הַ דַּ֔עַת לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּ נְּחֹ֑שֶׁת

traditions.KJV: and he was filled with wisdom , and understanding , and cunning to work all works in brass .

14.english_reference: And he came to king Solomon , and wrought all his work .

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבוֹא֙ אֶל הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת כָּל מְלַאכְתּֽ וֹ

traditions.KJV: And he came to king Solomon , and wrought all his work .

15.english_reference: For he cast two pillars of brass , of eighteen cubits high apiece :

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֛צַר אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הָ עַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָ עַמּ֣וּד הָ אֶחָ֔ד

traditions.KJV: For he cast two pillars of brass , of eighteen cubits high apiece :

15.english_reference: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about .

traditions.WLC: וְ חוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת הָ עַמּ֥וּד הַ שֵּׁנִֽי
traditions.VUL: et línea duódecim cubitórum ambiébat colúmnam utrámque .
traditions.KJV: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about .

traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον τῶν μεχωνώθ · συνκλειστὸν αὐτοῖς , καὶ συνκλειστὸν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἐξεχομένων .

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָ תֵ֛ת עַל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָֽ עַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת
traditions.VUL: Duo quoque capitélla fecit , quæ poneréntur super cápita columnárum , fusília ex ære :
traditions.KJV: And he made two chapiters [ of ] molten brass , to set upon the tops of the pillars :

traditions.WLC: חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַ כֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָ אֶחָ֔ת וְ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַ כֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַ שֵּׁנִֽית
